description: STAR publishes the commercial agencies that serve its Rennes transport network. The schema gives agency identifiers, locations, opening hours, number of counters, ticket and card services, payment options and whether live information is supported. These facility capacities and opening schedules can support queueing and access models for transport ticket services. The provider links a separate live agency-status dataset, already catalogued, which describes opening state and expected waiting time. The agency inventory provides structural attributes and does not establish actual counter staffing or observed customer demand at a given time. Current attribute completeness and the compatibility of historical agency versions with live observations remain unverified. Coverage follows the provider-described Rennes network. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. The source specifies ODbL licensing. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related agency-status data describes opening and waiting time.
